words.annotation: Oracle PL/SQL：対象・用語（Db2 SQL PL・PostgreSQL PL/pgSQLとは別。Oracle 19c以降の主要構文を中心に記載）
出力を有効化（SQL*Plus等のクライアントコマンド。PL/SQL構文ではない）

words.display: DECLARE v_name users.name%TYPE; BEGIN NULL; END;
words.input: DECLARE v_name users.name%TYPE; BEGIN NULL; END;
words.annotation: %TYPE：列等から型を継承（users表・name列が必要。制約・既定値をすべて継承するわけではない）

words.display:
DECLARE v_user users%ROWTYPE; BEGIN SELECT * INTO v_user FROM users WHERE id=1;
END;
words.input: DECLARE v_user users%ROWTYPE; BEGIN SELECT * INTO v_user FROM users WHERE id=1; END;
words.annotation: %ROWTYPE：行構造を変数化（users表が必要。SELECT INTOは正確に1行が必要）

words.display: DECLARE i PLS_INTEGER:=0; BEGIN LOOP i:=i+1; EXIT WHEN i>=3; END LOOP; END;
words.input: DECLARE i PLS_INTEGER:=0; BEGIN LOOP i:=i+1; EXIT WHEN i>=3; END LOOP; END;
words.annotation: LOOP / EXIT WHEN：無限ループから脱出

words.display: DECLARE i PLS_INTEGER:=0; BEGIN WHILE i<3 LOOP i:=i+1; END LOOP; END;
words.input: DECLARE i PLS_INTEGER:=0; BEGIN WHILE i<3 LOOP i:=i+1; END LOOP; END;

words.display: BEGIN FOR i IN REVERSE 1..3 LOOP DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(i); END LOOP; END;
words.input: BEGIN FOR i IN REVERSE 1..3 LOOP DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(i); END LOOP; END;
words.annotation: FOR / REVERSE：整数範囲の反復（両端を含む。制御変数は暗黙宣言）

words.display: BEGIN DELETE FROM users WHERE id=1; END;
words.input: BEGIN DELETE FROM users WHERE id=1; END;
words.annotation: DELETE：削除（実データ削除。COMMITまたはROLLBACKを判断）

words.display: BEGIN RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND; EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN RAISE; END;
words.input: BEGIN RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND; EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN RAISE; END;
words.annotation: RAISE：例外を再送出（意図的に例外が伝播）

words.display: DECLARE v_result NUMBER; BEGIN double_value(p_in=>2,p_out=>v_result); END;
words.input: DECLARE v_result NUMBER; BEGIN double_value(p_in=>2,p_out=>v_result); END;
words.annotation: 名前付き呼出：引数名で指定（double_valueが定義済み）

words.display:
CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE math_api AS FUNCTION twice(n NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER;
END;
words.input: CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE math_api AS FUNCTION twice(n NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER; END;
words.annotation: PACKAGE / PACKAGE BODY：宣言と実装を分離（呼出はmath_api.twice(2)等）

words.display: SELECT name,type,line,position,text FROM user_errors ORDER BY name,sequence;
words.input: SELECT name,type,line,position,text FROM user_errors ORDER BY name,sequence;
words.annotation: USER_ERRORS：コンパイルエラー確認（SQL。SHOW ERRORSはクライアントコマンド）
